name: Topsy-Turvy Town
pitch: The child wakes up in Wobbleton-on-the-Wiggle on the morning everything goes upside down, and sets off to get the town's great Giggle-Bell ringing again before the topsy-turviness becomes permanent.
setting: Wobbleton-on-the-Wiggle, a jumbly hilltop town of leaning houses, corkscrew chimneys, bridges that loop the loop, hills like scoops of sherbet, and tufty lollipop trees in every color

supportingCast.name: Mayor Fumbleflop
supportingCast.look: round little mayor with an enormous curly mustache, a sash covered in medals, and a hat shaped like a teapot

supportingCast.name: Professor Quibblewick
supportingCast.role: inventor who talks in big words
supportingCast.look: tall, bendy professor with spring-shaped hair, three pairs of spectacles pushed up on her head, and a coat with too many pockets

supportingCast.name: Zizzle
supportingCast.look: small fluffy orange creature with long floppy ears, polka-dot paws and a tail that curls into a spiral

supportingCast.name: The Grumblesnoot
supportingCast.role: grumpy creature who turns out to be lonely
supportingCast.look: big shaggy blue-green creature with droopy eyebrows, a long wiggly nose, and tiny mismatched socks

storyBeats: a wild ride on the loop-the-loop bridge
powerIdeas: The child fixes things with a clever, silly idea that uses one of their favorite things in a way nobody expected.

artDirection.mood: giddy, bouncy, wildly silly and warm-hearted

contentRules: silliness and cartoon chaos only; nothing frightening
the grumpy character is lonely, not wicked, and becomes a friend
grown-ups can be ridiculous but are never cruel
only original characters and invented words
